definitions.explanation: Being moderate or restrained in behavior, expression, or quantity. Avoiding excess or drawing attention to oneself.

examples.japanese: {控|ひか}え{目|め}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{控|ひか}え{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見積|みつも}って⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧だ。
examples.english: Even by modest estimation, she is excellent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{控|ひか}え{目|め}にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please go easy on the salt.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {控|ひか}え{目|め}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {控|ひか}え{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (modestly, in moderation)

NUANCE: {控|ひか}え{目|め} is generally positive when describing personality (modest, unassuming) but can be neutral when describing quantities (moderate amount). It's valued in Japanese culture as a sign of good manners.

ORTHOGRAPHY: Also written as ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧ or ひかえめ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (reserved personality)
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見積|みつも}って⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even by modest estimation)
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to moderate, go easy on)
- {控|ひか}え{目|め}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (modest attitude)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{謙虚|けんきょ}→謙虚：00215_kenkyo⟧ (humble, modest)
- ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}がち→遠慮がち：18202_enryogachi⟧ (reserved, hesitant)
- ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧ (plain, subdued)
- おとなしい (quiet, gentle)
